steps.title: Find the starting cube
steps.instruction: The default cube becomes the organiser. Make sure you are in Object Mode.
steps.why: Starting from a simple shape is how most models begin.

steps.title: Size the box: 30 × 20 × 10 cm
steps.instruction: Set the cube's dimensions to X 0.3 m, Y 0.2 m, Z 0.1 m.
steps.why: Real objects have real sizes; working to measurements keeps a model believable.
hints: Press N with the mouse over the 3D Viewport to open the Sidebar.
Type each value and press Enter.

steps.title: Apply the scale
steps.instruction: Apply the scale so the object's scale is 1, 1, 1 while its size stays 30 × 20 × 10 cm.
steps.why: Modifiers such as Bevel work on the unscaled shape; an unapplied scale makes bevels uneven.

ui_hint.path: 3D Viewport > Object menu > Apply > Scale (or Ctrl+A > Scale)

steps.title: Add a Bevel modifier
steps.instruction: Add a Bevel modifier to round the box's edges.
steps.why: Few real objects have perfectly sharp edges; bevels catch the light.

ui_hint.path: Properties > Modifiers (wrench) > Add Modifier > Generate > Bevel

steps.title: Set the bevel: 5 mm, 3 segments
steps.instruction: Set the Bevel Amount to 0.005 m and Segments to 3.

steps.title: Delete the top face
steps.instruction: Press Tab for Edit Mode, switch to Face Select, click the top face and delete it (X > Faces). Confirm when the box is open.
steps.why: An open top turns a solid block into a container.

ui_hint.path: 3D Viewport header > Mode menu > Edit Mode, then Face Select (or press Tab, then 3)

hints: Orbit the view with the middle mouse button to see the top face.
Press Numpad Period to zoom to the selected object.

steps.title: Give the walls thickness
steps.instruction: Return to Object Mode and add a Solidify modifier with Thickness 0.005 m.
steps.why: A deleted face leaves walls with no thickness; Solidify makes them solid.

ui_hint.path: Properties > Modifiers (wrench) > Add Modifier > Generate > Solidify

steps.title: Give it a wood material
steps.instruction: Create a new material and name it Wood.

ui_hint.path: Properties > Material (red sphere) > New, then rename it to Wood
